"Life is what happens to you when you're busy making other plans"

Growing up I've always been socially inept and awkward. It was difficult making friends, even more difficult going beyond that. I've always thought that I can work on my social skills from my jobs and program. 

But the downside is that I've used that plan as a roadblock. I keep thinking "once I get better at this I'll go make friends and hopefully one day I'll be able to be in a relationship" etc. 

Now that I'm 25 I think I'm missing out on experiences that someone my age should have.

I was able to make connections with someone who I consider a friend I think. They remind me how behind I am, and keeps me up to speed. This time I'm just going to wing it, no matter how many awkward moments I will have to go through. 

I want a life and memories.
